question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **'rejected'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rejected **means** to have been dismissed as inadequate or unacceptable**.

 
 
• *Example - The factory workers' demand for increased pay was **rejected** by the authorities.*
 
 
 
• The King's scheme was not accepted in the parliament because of its unethical means of accumulating finances.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 2.**

Correct Passage:__ *The British king, Charles I, had (1) __inherited__ a very difficult financial situation from his father. His period saw a very high rate of inflation. He wanted to (2) __raise__ money. Therefore, he (3) __started__ creating the title of Baronet and selling it to (4) __wealthy__ candidates. However, his decision was **(5)** __**rejected**__ by the British parliament.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's have a look at the **meaning **of other words given in options:-

 
 
• **Banished - **send (someone) away from a country or place as an official punishment.
 
• **Unaccepted - **not given acceptance.
 
• **Abandoned - **having been deserted or left.
